title: Derived tensor preserves open support in either factor
statement: Let d, t and o be the ordinary or vertical pro-etale geometric and operation data [def-sf-open-normalization-data]. For every derived restricted-ring module M on U and every derived ambient-ring module N on X, the object tensorX(j! M,N) belongs to the essential image of j!. No projection-formula arrow or normalization is part of this statement.

proof.text: The underived localized extension/tensor formula applies in every bidegree. Exact open extension preserves direct sums, so these comparisons sum to a chain isomorphism and commute with both differentials, including the total sign.

The same chain formula against an acyclic test complex proves that extension preserves K-flatness. The underived formula and the exactness criterion for tensor prove preservation of flat terms. Restriction preserves the resolving class. Resolve both factors and use the representative comparisons to obtain an isomorphism from the ambient derived tensor to extension of an object on the open.

Use the vertical ringed diagram site itself for systems, so the whole construction is compatible with arbitrary semilinear transitions. Essential-image membership is independent of the supplied compatible tensor and exact extension presentations.
